text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 and common colds share some overlapping symptoms, but key differences can help distinguish between them. Common cold symptoms include a runny or stuffy nose, sore throat, sneezing, cough, mild fever, and fatigue. COVID-19, however, can present with these, plus diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, shortness of breath, and a new loss of taste or smell. The presence of shortness of breath or loss of taste/smell is more suggestive of COVID-19.
